question: In 2025, which schemes provide retired athletes career transition support, financial aid, and medical benefits?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RESET and Pandit Deendayal Fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **RESET (Retired Sports Excellence and Transition)** is a government initiative aimed at providing **career transition support**, financial aid, and **medical benefits** to retired athletes who have represented India at various national and international sporting events.
 
• The scheme focuses on **reskilling and upskilling** athletes to help them transition into new careers post-retirement. It includes training, education, and job placement services.
 
• The **Pandit Deendayal Fund** is another scheme that provides **financial assistance** to athletes who are in need, especially post-retirement. It is designed to ensure **financial security** and promote a dignified life for retired sportspersons.
 
• Both schemes are managed under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, ensuring proper implementation and support to athletes who have contributed to the country’s sporting achievements.
